title: Harrington Park Residence
summary: A whole-home refresh for a young family — calm, light-filled living spaces built around texture and natural timber.
brief: The owners of this Harrington Park home came to us with a familiar story: a house full of good bones that never quite felt finished. Rooms were furnished but not composed, and the palette drifted from space to space.
Our brief was to bring the whole ground floor together — living, dining and kitchen — with a scheme that felt calm and cohesive, without losing the warmth of a family home.

photos.heading: The Living Room
photos.text: The living room sets the tone: a soft neutral base, layered textures, and a custom rug that anchors the seating area. Timber and brass details carry through the rest of the home.

photos.heading: The Lounge
photos.text: Deep, comfortable seating in hard-wearing fabrics — chosen for real family life, not just photographs. The gold accents pick up the afternoon light from the north-facing windows.

photos.heading: The Kitchen
photos.text: Finishes in the kitchen were kept crisp and simple, letting the stone island do the talking.

photos.heading: The Dining Space
photos.text: A relaxed dining space that connects indoors and out. The palette repeats the living room's tones so the whole floor reads as one composition.
